build: Beef Release, GNU linker, ThinLTO unavailable; native Release
timesteps: one fixed 60 Hz physics tick per sample/frame
graphics: Vulkan; render=1280x720 no AA/shadows; hq=1920x1080 AA+shadows
sampling: Exact warmup/samples/repeats in manifest commands; summary contains medians and worst-process p95
scheduling: Sequential unpinned processes, ordinary desktop, uncontrolled background load/clocks
scope: Single-player processes; no live network, no production queue or compute implementation
timing_warning: SAMPLE timings exclude reset/validation; full FRAME intervals include that benchmark housekeeping.
